This land is not mine — I rent it, so I do not want to spend too much on expensive inputs. Beans and legumes give their own nitrogen to the soil, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer this season, especially since prices are high and the plot is not mine to improve. But the insects that attack cowpea are very serious — without spraying, the pods will be destroyed, so I must buy some pesticide. I will work the plot with my own hands and call one or two people to help during weeding and harvest.
